mostWorthwhile.text: Building the two kinds of proteins was most worthwhile: comparing the muscle fibres inside cells with the supporting fibres around cells made their different jobs clearer.

leastWorthwhile.text: The supporting-cell sequence repeated the muscle sequence, though the different final result gave the repetition a purpose.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the supporting cells released protein to build material around themselves, rather than keeping the fibres inside like the muscle cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although I followed the named messenger pairings without knowing the detailed mechanism by which they activate genes.

continue.text: I would continue to see how these different cells become tissues and organs; the contrast between their jobs gives me a reason to see what comes next.
